card.name: Drug interaction section wording and drug names
card.fires_on: Words inside drug-interaction sections: the word "drug" before "interactions", and partway through interacting drug names or the word "concomitant". It also fires on punctuation right after an interacting drug name.

modes.label: Before interactions
modes.description: The word "drug" just before "interactions" in cross-reference lines.
modes.example: See FPI for more important<< drug>> interactions.

modes.label: Inside interacting drug names
modes.description: Partway through the name of a co-administered drug listed in an interaction section.

modes.label: Concomitant and list punctuation
modes.description: Partway through "concomitant" or on a closing bracket or colon after an interacting drug name.
